---
title: "Hallmark pathway bootstrap stability"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
params:
  bootstrap_iterations: 500
  random_seed: 20260805
---

Fit the three MSI/TMB contrasts on the sample-level Hallmark ssGSEA scores and resample patients within MSI/TMB groups. Export the limma contrast estimates and bootstrap stability summaries used in Figure 3.

```{r project-root, include=FALSE}
project_root <- Sys.getenv("MSS_TMB_PROJECT_ROOT", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(project_root)) {
  project_root <- file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "..")
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(project_root, mustWork = TRUE))
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(limma)
library(knitr)

iterations <- params$bootstrap_iterations
stopifnot(length(iterations) == 1L, is.finite(iterations),
          iterations >= 2, iterations == floor(iterations))
set.seed(params$random_seed)

groups <- c("MSI_H", "MSS_TMB_H", "MSS_TMB_L")
group_labels <- c("MSI-H", "MSS/TMB-H", "MSS/TMB-L")
output_root <- "bootstrap_validated_downstream_analysis/results/GSEA_bootstrap"
```

## Fit primary and bootstrap contrasts

```{r bootstrap-functions}
summarize_pathways <- function(scores_file, clinical_file, cohort) {
  scores <- as.matrix(read.csv(scores_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
  clinical <- read.csv(clinical_file)
  normalize_id <- function(ids) toupper(gsub(".", "-", ids, fixed = TRUE))
  clinical_ids <- normalize_id(clinical$sample_submitter_id)
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(clinical_ids), !anyDuplicated(colnames(scores)),
            is.numeric(scores), all(is.finite(scores)))

  group <- factor(
    clinical$MSI_TMB[match(normalize_id(colnames(scores)), clinical_ids)],
    levels = group_labels,
    labels = groups
  )
  scores <- scores[, !is.na(group), drop = FALSE]
  group <- group[!is.na(group)]
  group_indices <- split(seq_along(group), group)
  if (any(lengths(group_indices) < 2L)) {
    stop(cohort, " requires at least two scored samples in each MSI/TMB group.")
  }

  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
  colnames(design) <- groups
  contrasts <- makeContrasts(
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L,
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H = MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H,
    MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L,
    levels = design
  )

  fit_contrasts <- function(indices) {
    fit <- lmFit(scores[, indices, drop = FALSE], design[indices, , drop = FALSE])
    eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts))
  }

  primary <- fit_contrasts(seq_len(ncol(scores)))
  boot <- array(NA_real_, c(nrow(scores), ncol(contrasts), iterations))
  for (iteration in seq_len(iterations)) {
    indices <- unlist(lapply(group_indices, function(idx) {
      sample(idx, length(idx), replace = TRUE)
    }), use.names = FALSE)
    boot[, , iteration] <- fit_contrasts(indices)$coefficients
  }

  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(ncol(contrasts)), function(j) {
    effects <- matrix(boot[, j, ], nrow = nrow(scores))
    primary_effect <- primary$coefficients[, j]
    tested <- is.finite(effects)
    data.frame(
      Contrast = colnames(contrasts)[j],
      pathway = rownames(scores),
      primary_logFC = unname(primary_effect),
      primary_FDR = p.adjust(primary$p.value[, j], method = "BH"),
      tested_rate = rowMeans(tested),
      bootstrap_sign_consistency = rowMeans(
        ifelse(tested, sign(effects) == sign(primary_effect), NA),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      bootstrap_median_logFC = apply(effects, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE),
      bootstrap_logFC_q025 = apply(effects, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      bootstrap_logFC_q975 = apply(effects, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }))
}
```

## Export cohort summaries

```{r export, results='asis'}
inputs <- list(
  CRC = c("data/prepared/gsva_ssgsea_hallmark.csv", "data/clinical_data.csv"),
  UCEC = c("data/prepared/ucec_gsva_ssgsea_hallmark.csv", "data/ucec_clinical.csv")
)

for (cohort in names(inputs)) {
  files <- inputs[[cohort]]
  summary <- summarize_pathways(files[1], files[2], cohort)
  output_dir <- file.path(output_root, cohort)
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write.csv(summary, file.path(output_dir, paste0(cohort, "_GSVA_bootstrap_stability_summary.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  print(kable(head(summary), caption = paste(cohort, "Hallmark pathway stability")))
}
```
